A1.justification: Both 11-page PDFs describe the same CMT/mmABC work, with readable text, equations, figures and tables supporting reliable comparison. Neither supplied PDF includes an appendix, although both refer to supplementary material.

before.justification: Section 5 reports original CMT generation experiments, human and MLLM evaluations, and ablations in Tables 2–6, with qualitative results in Figures 3–5.

after.justification: Section 5 retains the original CMT experimental outcomes, evaluations and ablations in Tables 2–6 and Figures 3–5.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Figure 2 retain identical continuous tokenization, multimodal encoding, edge-then-surface generation, topology prediction and training objectives.

E1.justification: Both versions use ABC and DeepCAD for unconditional generation and mmABC for point-cloud-, image- and text-conditioned generation. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged: Table 2 uses DeepCAD, SolidGen and BrepGen on DeepCAD, and BrepGen on ABC. Tables 3–5 retain ComplexGen/Point2CAD/NVDNet/DeepCAD for point clouds, InstantMesh for images, and Michelangelo for text.

E3.justification: Sections 5.1–5.3 retain the same splits, training budgets, sequence lengths, sampling procedures and metrics. Single-image evaluation and text evaluation using 20 models and 10 CAD designers are also unchanged.

E4.justification: Section 5.4 and Table 6 retain the same cascade-versus-single-network ablation and sampling-step analysis, ranging from 64/32 to 1/1 steps. No robustness or supplementary analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates and win rates without reporting repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All reported numerical and qualitative results are retained. For example, CMT's ABC COV and Valid remain 68.60 and 58.5 in Table 2, and its image-conditioned Chamfer remains 2.17 in Table 4.

T1.justification: Section 4 retains the same mathematical definitions and formulations, including token representations, topology prediction and losses in Equations 1–4. Neither PDF contains additional theorems or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same scientific contributions and novelty claims concerning CMT, its cascade/topology design and mmABC. Dataset-scale and performance claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: The explanations linking topology priors and autoregressive generation to performance remain unchanged. The conclusion retains multi-body generation and model completion as future work, without new substantive limitations or qualifications.

D1.justification: The v1 abstract promises release of the dataset, code and pretrained network; v2 removes that statement without supplying replacement access information. Implementation details remain unchanged, and the PDFs do not establish a change in actual resource availability.

R1.justification: The same 52 references and related-work discussion are retained. Positioning against command-sequence and diffusion-based CAD methods is unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 updates author affiliations, adds contact emails and funding acknowledgements, and removes the abstract's release sentence. The scientific prose and main section organization otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The expanded author block shifts Figure 1 and the abstract, while the conclusion and reference pages reflow around the added acknowledgements. All five figures and six tables retain their content, captions and structure.

improvement.justification: The method, experimental evidence, scientific claims and implementation instructions are unchanged. v2 adds funding and contact disclosures but removes a prospective resource-release statement; neither version provides resource access instructions. These limited disclosure and layout edits leave overall scientific quality and practical reproducibility essentially unchanged.
